[[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles's]] '''tracker utility vest''' was a sleeveless item of clothing that included several evenly-distributed pockets. A wearer&mdash;commonly a hunter or a guide&mdash;could carry up to 24 light tools and the design of the vest would reduce the effect of the load on him. The vest was made of leathery, hide material to resist rips, corrosion and water. It was readily available from the times of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The tracker utility vest was a simple<ref name="C">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> sleeveless garment.<ref name="A" /> It had several pockets, pouches and strap allowing the wearer to carry up to twenty-four individual items, each of them weighing up to one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. Due to the nature of the garment, the total weight would be distributed evenly through the wearer's torso, reducing the real strain to her muscles. An empty vest weighed 0.5 kilograms.<ref name="B" />

The tracker utility vest could be manufactured from several materials,<ref name="C" /> but it was commonly made from a naturally leathery and hard one<ref name="B" /> such as the hide of a [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]].<ref name="A" /> That hide would then be treated so it can resist rips, tears and corrosion, and to be impermeable to both stains<ref name="B" /> and water.<ref name="C" /> The vest provided a slight amount of protection against damage, enough for it to be considered a light armor, and at the same time it rarely hampered the movements of the wearer.<ref name="B" />

==History==
The tracker utility vest was designed by the [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] company<ref name="A" /> to give comfort to hunters and guides needing to carry an amount of small tools. It was sold by 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="B" /> from the times of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] up to the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="A" /> Its sale was not restricted.<ref name="B" />

==Behind the scenes==
First listed in ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' ([[2002]]), the vest included [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] rules to reduce the total amount of weight carried by a character, allowing her to avoid a penalization to her stats for excessive load. The rules were adapted to the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition Roleplaying Game'']] in ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' ([[2009]]).
